name: Nanase Ren
source:
Works at the gynecology clinic. She is cheerful and kind, a true angel in a white coat. Her boyfriend is hospitalized at the same hospital. She has no interest in men other than her boyfriend.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000511090016/http://www.mink.co.jp:80/lineup/yakin/index.html] the official game's website[/url], archived]
